title: M3-01: Admin Creates Restaurants + Menus
desc: Admin can create a restaurant and its full menu through the admin panel. This is how we onboard the first 10-20 restaurants before the owner portal exists.

ac.t: POST /api/admin/restaurants — ADMIN creates restaurant (name, photo_url, avg_price, address)
POST /api/admin/restaurants/{uuid}/items — ADMIN adds menu items to any restaurant
PUT /api/admin/restaurants/{uuid}/items/{itemUuid} — ADMIN edits any menu item
DELETE /api/admin/restaurants/{uuid}/items/{itemUuid} — ADMIN removes menu item
POST /api/admin/restaurants/{uuid}/categories — ADMIN assigns categories
Admin Dashboard > Restaurants tab: "Add Restaurant" button opens creation form
Admin Dashboard > Restaurant detail view: menu item CRUD (add/edit/delete)
New restaurant defaults to status = ACTIVE
Admin can create a restaurant + 20 menu items in under 15 minutes

title: M3-02: PENDING Approval Flow
desc: Self-registered restaurants land in PENDING, not ACTIVE. Admin reviews and approves. Marketplace trust gate.

ac.t: Restaurant status extended: PENDING | ACTIVE | SUSPENDED
Self-registered restaurants default to PENDING
Admin-created restaurants default to ACTIVE (skip approval)
GET /api/restaurant (public) excludes PENDING restaurants
Admin Dashboard > Restaurants: filter by status, "Approve" button for PENDING
PUT /api/admin/restaurants/{uuid}/status accepts PENDING, ACTIVE, SUSPENDED
Restaurant owner sees "Pending approval" banner when PENDING

title: M3-03: Restaurant Owner Invite Link
desc: Admin generates unique signup link per restaurant. Owner clicks, creates account, auto-linked as RESTAURANT_OWNER. Single-use, 7-day expiry.

ac.t: POST /api/admin/restaurants/{uuid}/invite — generates unique invite token (UUID, 7-day expiry)
DB migration: invite_tokens table (id, token, restaurant_id, expires_at, used_at)
GET /api/invite/{token} — public, returns restaurant name + invite status
Frontend: /invite/{token} route — shows restaurant name + "Create account to manage"
On signup/login via invite: user auto-assigned RESTAURANT_OWNER + linked to restaurant
Invite token marked as used (single-use)
Admin Dashboard > Restaurant detail: "Generate Invite Link" button, copyable URL
Expired/used token shows clear error message

title: M3-04: Owner Portal — Backend
desc: Self-serve portal. Owners without invite create new restaurant (PENDING). Owners via invite manage pre-created restaurant.

ac.t: DB migration: ALTER TABLE restaurant ADD COLUMN owner_id REFERENCES customer(id)
POST /api/restaurant — RESTAURANT_OWNER creates restaurant (status=PENDING)
PUT /api/restaurant/{uuid} — owner edits own restaurant only
POST /api/restaurant/{uuid}/item — add menu item
PUT /api/restaurant/{uuid}/item/{itemUuid} — edit item
DELETE /api/restaurant/{uuid}/item/{itemUuid} — remove item
GET /api/restaurant/mine — list restaurants owned by current user
403 if restaurant owner_id does not match authenticated user
New RestaurantOwnerController.java

title: M3-05: Owner Portal — Frontend
desc: /my-restaurant route with RESTAURANT_OWNER guard. Create/edit restaurant, menu CRUD, orders, status badge.

ac.t: /my-restaurant route with RESTAURANT_OWNER role guard
"My Restaurants" list page (shows status badge: PENDING/ACTIVE/SUSPENDED)
Create restaurant form (name, photo URL, avg price, address)
Edit restaurant details
Menu item management: add / edit / delete with name, price, type (VEG/NON_VEG)
Incoming orders list for their restaurant(s)
"Pending approval" banner when restaurant is PENDING
Uses existing app theme (Poppins, coral-red)

title: M3-06: /for-restaurants Landing Page
desc: Public marketing page. Hero + benefits + CTA. "Zero commission for 3 months." Drives self-serve signups.

ac.t: /for-restaurants route — public, no auth required
Hero: "Reach more hungry customers" + "Zero commission for first 3 months"
3 benefit sections (more orders, easy menu management, real-time insights)
"Get Started" CTA redirects to /login?role=restaurant_owner
Login page detects param, auto-assigns RESTAURANT_OWNER after signup
Footer link: "Partner with us" pointing to /for-restaurants
Mobile responsive, matches app theme

title: M3-07: Docker Compose
desc: docker-compose.yml at root. PostgreSQL 17 (seeded), backend + frontend containers. Fresh clone to running app.

ac.t: docker-compose.yml at project root
PostgreSQL 17 container (port 5434, restaurantdb, auto-seeded with tables.sql + migrations)
Backend container (waits for DB health check, builds with Maven)
Frontend container (nginx serving React build)
docker compose up on fresh clone = app running at localhost:3000
.dockerignore files to exclude node_modules, target, .git

title: M3-08: QA — Milestone 3 E2E
desc: Full E2E: admin creates restaurant + menu, invite link flow, owner self-serve, PENDING approval, Docker.

ac.t: Admin creates restaurant + 10 menu items in under 15 minutes
Admin generates invite link, opens in incognito, signs up = auto-linked as owner
Owner creates restaurant via self-serve = status PENDING, admin approves = visible on home
Owner edits menu items on their own restaurant only
Owner cannot access another owner restaurant (403)
PENDING restaurants do not appear in public listing
/for-restaurants page renders, CTA works
Docker Compose: fresh clone, docker compose up, app running

title: M4-01: Order Tracking
desc: Order status flow: PLACED > CONFIRMED > PREPARING > OUT_FOR_DELIVERY > DELIVERED. MUI Stepper. 30s polling.

ac.t: DB migration: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(30) DEFAULT PLACED NOT NULL
Status flow: PLACED > CONFIRMED > PREPARING > OUT_FOR_DELIVERY > DELIVERED
GET /api/order/{uuid}/status — returns current status
PUT /api/order/{uuid}/status — ADMIN or RESTAURANT_OWNER can update
Frontend: tracking page with MUI Stepper showing order progress
30s polling for status updates
Order confirmation page redirects to tracking after placement
